newsitem.title: UKRAINE: IMF mission in Ukraine for stand-by loan talks.
newsitem.headline: IMF mission in Ukraine for stand-by loan talks.

text.p: An International Monetary Fund (IMF) mission arrived in Ukraine on Monday to discuss an interim stand-by credit for Kiev pending a bigger long-term loan, an IMF spokesman said on Monday.

The credit, which could be delivered by next month, would be used until the former Soviet republic meets 41 conditions to qualify for a three-year, $2.5 billion to $3.0 billion Extended Fund Facility (EFF) aimed to support economic restructuring.
Neither IMF nor Ukrainian officials have detailed the expected amount of the stand-by credit.
The mission visit is due to finish at the end of the week.
Ukraine, which still has to fulfil several conditions, could qualify for the EFF by the end of this year or early in 1998, IMF officials have said previously.
